items.title: 18.2.1 Limitations to the Law of Independent Assortment (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the limits of independent assortment (PDF 88-89).

blocks.text: Law of independent assortment bohat se genes ki virasat samjhata hai, lekin har genetic paicheedgi (complexity) ka ihata nahi karta.

items: Linked genes: aik hi chromosome par qareeb genes aksar ikatthe virasat mein jate hain, azadana nahi (gene linkage).
Chromosome crossover: meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan genetic maadde ka tabadla, is liye gene milapon ki nisbat andaze se mukhtalif ho sakti hai.
Epistasis: aik gene ka asar aik ya zyada ghair mutaliq genes badal ya daba dete hain, jis se mutawaqqa nisbatein badal jati hain.
Pleiotropy: aik gene kai khasiyatein qaboo karta hai, is liye woh khasiyatein juri hui lagti hain aur nisbatein bigar sakti hain.
Mahol ka asar: bohat se phenotypes mahol se mutasir hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Do genes aik hi chromosome par qareeb hain. Kya woh 9:3:3:1 qaida maanenge? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par nahi. Linked genes gametes mein ikatthe rehte hain, is liye parental milap zyada hote aur 9:3:3:1 nahi milti.

items: Hudood: linkage, crossing over, epistasis, pleiotropy, mahol.
